tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nor lha'i skyed chog g.yang 'bod byed tshul bcas bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ 'dir nor lha 'khor bcas bskyed de spyan drangs nas mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ g.yang 'bod byed tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas yid dang mthun par nor lha 'khor bcas kyi sku yod na bkram/ med na/ mdun du stegs kyi khar dar ras sam shog gu'i ngos la gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ mthar bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs bris pa bzhag ste/ steng du 'bras sam/ /gro nas sogs kyis tshom bu brgyad dam bcu drug byas la/ mthar mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs gang 'byor dang*/ mngar gsum dang mar khus bsgos pa'i zlum gtor dgu'am gcig bshams 'byor na longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du rin bo che'i rigs dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyang bya'o/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs spyi ltar byas nas/ /rang nyid skad cig gis phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs par gyur/ / mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ 'dod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas de bzhin du sbyar te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ dang*/ rū ba āḥhūṃ nas/ sparasha āḥhūṃ/ thal mo bkan te snyim pa'i tshul du byas pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba taṅkha ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/

lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs/ rgyas par byed na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlabs bya'o/ /de nas lha bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ spy-ir rnam sras gtso bor byas pa'i lha dgu dang*/ dzam+bha la dang nor rgyun ma re re nas gtso bor byas pa'i lha dgu ma gnyis dang*/ yang lha yab yum so sor phye ba'i lha bco brgyad ma dang*/ de la'ang yab rnams rta la chibs pa dang*/ de med pa'i lugs gnyis dang*/ yab yum rnams phyag mtshan 'dra ba dang*/ mi 'dra ba'i tshul mang du snang ba las 'dir lugs gcig gi dbang du bya'o/ /de yang*/ /a mṛ tas bsangs swabhā was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi ba/ pha gu dang dra ba dra phyed mda' yab sogs dang bcas pa'i thog gi rtse mor nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ nang gi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zla gdan dang bcas pa de'i mtha' skor du gter bum brgyad dang dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad la sogs pas bskor ba/ dbus kyi pad zla'i gdan la dzam ser bo de yongs su gyur pa la dzam+bha la ser bo g.yas sa bon gyi grong khyer dang*/ g.yon ne'u le rin po che skyugs pa 'dzin cing*/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i 'og na dung dang pad+ma'i gter bsnam pa/ shar du nor bu bzang bo/ lhor gang ba bzang bo/ nub tu nor sbyin/ byang du rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rol ba'i 'phreng ba/ lho nub tu pi tsi kun+ṭa li/ nub byang du gdong gi dbang bo/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang bo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po g.yas badz+ra pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ ut+pa la'i 'phreng ba dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo la sogs pa'i dku g.yon phyogs su rim pa bzhin du lha mo nor rgyun ma dang*/

chu shel ma dang*/ so ma dang*/ so legs ma dang*/ 'phags ma dang*/ shin tu bzang mo dang*/ sbas ma dang*/ rab sbas ma dang*/ dbyangs can ma ste/ thams cad kyang g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud ba'i tshul mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ bud med sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur can no/ /de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la dbus su sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser bo/ /g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas rin po che bsnams pa/ mdun byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod/ /g.yas su nam mkha'i snying bo/ /rgyab tu spos kyi glang bo che/ /g.yon du phyag na rdo rje ste sems dpa' thams cad kyang sku mdog ser bo g.yas rin po che 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dkur bsten pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs skyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi mthar tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs lha'i nor lha rnams dang nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu'i nor lha 'khor dang bcas pas bskor ba/ /de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros lcang lo can la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la la sogs pa'i nor lha'i tshogs dang*/ rin 'byung 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gang sngon bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa kun sel dngos grub mchog /ster mdzad nor lha 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra abhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes gsungs shing*/

rin po che'i bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las nor lha thams cad la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur bar bsams la/ lha mi'i mchod yon rgya mtsho dang*/ / bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /nor lha'i tshogs rnams kun la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong gi/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā r+ya dzam+bha la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil me tog sogs bcu gnas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ spar+sha'i bar mchod cing*/ gzugs mchog dang*/ sgra snyan/ dri mchog sogs sbyor tshul shes par bya'o/ /rin chen bdun 'bul na/ lha mi'i 'khor lo rin chen dang*/ zhes sogs sbyar nas 'bul lo/ /bstod pa ni/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la/ /nor lha 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro kun dbul phongs sdug bsngal mun pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis sel mdzad pa/ /nor lha chen po yab yum 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas bstod gsol mchog thun dngos grub bstsol/ /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ /bde gshegs rin 'byung rgyal ba'i sras bzhi dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs bcas pa/ /mchod bstod gsol 'debs 'dod rgu'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ /de nas/ nor lha thams cad kyi thugs khar rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas rang gzhan thams cad la thim par gyur/ par bsams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ pū rā bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya swā hā/

oṃ ki li mi li ne swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kun+ṭa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa yab rnams kyi snying bo dang*/ oṃ ba su dha ri ni swā hā/ oṃ tsan+t+ra kān+t+ye swā hā/ oṃ dan+tā ye swā hā/ oṃ su dan+tā ye swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya ye swā hā/ oṃ su bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ gup+ta ye swā hā/ oṃ de byai ye swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai swā hā/ zhes yum rnams kyi snying bo ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la dza len+da ya rat+na sing+nghi dza hūṃ hrīḥthā/ zhes dang*/ na mo de ba dzam+bha la ya swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ na mo na ga dzam+bha= na mo yak+ṣa= na mo rak+ṣa= na mo su r+ya= na mo tsan+d+ra= ma ma ba su de hi de hi puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dang*/ na mo dzaṃbha la dza len+d+ra ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sam sam/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsan+dha tsan+dha/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sa tra ya ni/ at+ma ya ni dha ra tu swā hā/ ār+ya dzam+bha la dha na da la swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas nas/ mthar yig brgya brjod/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ shap+ta'i par gyis mchod de/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter gyi bdag /yo byad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /sgrub pa po la 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol ba/ /nor lha 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pā ri wa ra i maṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis phul te/

sngar gyi bstod pa de rnams gang rung gis bstod nas/ nor lha'i rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu'o/ /de nas g.yang 'bod mi byed na/ skabs 'dir yig brgya brjod/ rten yod na/ ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byas te/ bdag gzhan 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /dgyes bzhin dbyer med bzhugs nas ni/ /dgos 'dod thams cad stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ bkra shis bya la rten med na/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ mgron thams cad rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes bya'o/ /tshul de ltar bsgrub cing mchod bstod bzlas pa byas nas bsod nams longs spyod thams cad 'phel zhing*/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bar gsungs so/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i g.yang 'bod nor lha'i sgrub thabs dang sprel na legs mod/ sger du byas kyang chog tsam yin pas gang bde bya'o/ /gong gi nor lha'i yab brgyad po de rnams gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rta bdag brgyad dang ngo bo gcig yin yang*/ sku'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba tsam ste/ rgyud rgya gzhung sogs nas bshad pas rang bza ོ min zhing*/ yid ches pa'i gnas so/ /grub na zhag bdun nam gsum mam zhag gcig tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas gnyis pa g.yang 'bod byed par 'dod na rten snod bzang bo zhig gi nang du rin po che'i rigs dang 'bru dri sman gos dar kyi rigs dang*/ phyug po'i lag nas 'ongs pa'i nor rdzas sogs dang*/ nor lha'i snying bo rnams bris pa bcug ste/ mdun du stegs kyi khar 'jog cing*/ mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsham/ /grub na g.yang rten gyi nang du nor bu g.yung drung sogs bris ba'i byang bu yang 'jug cing*/ mda' dar sogs kyang sta gon bya/

dkar gsum mnga' gsum gyis bsgo ba'i zhal zas kyi mthar yod na mar zho 'o ma thud shing tog sogs 'jog /thog mar bgegs bskrad byas na legs pas bgegs gtor gsum mam gcig ting lo dang bcas pa byas la bsngo tshul rgyas bsdus gnyis las bsdus pa zhig brjod na/ rang nyid phyag rdor ram/ rta mgrin nam/ hūṃ mdzad lta bu khro bo gang yang rung ba zhig tu bskyed de/ bsangs sbyangs/ / stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs kyi lan gsum bsngo/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i longs spyod spyi dang g.yang 'du ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad/ rgyang ring du song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na/ khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje mer rab tu 'bar bas bsreg cing rnam par 'joms pa gdon mi za'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a mri ta'i mjug tu/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum brjod cing*/ yungs kar dang bye ma sogs kyis brab par bya'o/ /rgyas par na khro bo spyan drangs nas bstod pa sogs byas kyang chog go /mchod pa gzhan sngar ltar la/ g.yang rten gyi rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdza bum sogs kyi nang du g.yang rten gyi rdzas bzhag pa de la dmigs nas/ a mri tas bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i dang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdzas rnams 'dod rgu'i mi zad 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ /oṃ pañca rat+na be ga a mri ta āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum mam bdun nam/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngar bzhin byas he/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas khaṃ swāhā'i bar sngar ltar lan gsum/ rgyas par na sngags drug gis byin gyis brlab pa la/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyis bden pa'i byin brlab bya'o/ /de nas g.yang 'bod kyi skyabs yul nor lha gong du bskyed pa de rnams kyis chog mod/ 'on kyang sger du spyan 'dren byed pa'i lugs snang ba bzhin byas na'ang legs cing*/ de yang gser 'od g.yang skyob/ pad+ma g.yang 'bum sogs nas 'byung ba ni rnying ma'i lugs gtso bor byas par snang zhing*/ tshig sbyor spro zlos cung che bar snang bas 'jug pa mi bde'i/ / 'dir 'jug pa bde khul du bya nas/ spos bzang bo sbar nas/ /dzaḥrtsa brgyud bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum zhi khro'i tshogs/ /sems dpa' brgyad sogs rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol/ /dzam la rnam sras nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha klu gzhi bdag mthu chen thams cad kyang*/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /skyabs yul dam pa 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ / gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs/ /'dod yon lnga dang rin chen snang bdun dang*/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rin chen 'bru sman dri/ /gos dar mar thud 'o zho shing tog dang*/ /khyad par dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru bcud las/ /legs par bgyis pa'i gtor ma'i rgya mtsho 'bul/ / oṃ a kā ro lan

gsum brjod de bsngo/ /yang na/ gong ltar rgyas par 'bul/ de nas mda' dar ram/ dar dkar sogs g.yob cing g.yang 'bod pa ni/ / hruṃ bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / rin chen rigs rnams kun gyi gtso/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ / rgyal sras nam mkha' mdzod la sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dang*/ /yi dam bstan srung thams cad kyang*/ /dar dkar g.yob cing spyan 'dren na/ /bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /myur byon bdag dang yon bdag la/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rta phyugs dngos grub= rin chen dngos grub= /'bru yi= /gos dar= /zas skom= /dbang thang = /dpal 'byor= / longs spyod= /snyan grags dngos grub= /'khor g.yog= /mthu dpal= /bsod nams= /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /kyai dzam+bha la dang nor bu bzang*/ /gang ba bzang bo nor sbyin che/ /rnam mang thos sras rol pa'i 'phreng*/ /lnga rtsen gdong gi dbang bo dang*/ /spyod pa'i dbang bor bcas rnams kyang*/ /dar dkar g.yo ba= /bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas= /myur byon= /tshe yi= /rta phyugs= /rin chen= /'bru yi= /gos dar= /zas skom= /dbang thang = /dpal 'byor= /longs spyod= /snyan grags= /'khor g.yog= /mthu dpal= /bsod nams= dngos grub thams cad= /nor rgyun ma dang chu shel ma/ /so ma so legs 'phags ma dang*/ /shin tu bzang mo sbas ma dang*/ /rab tu sbas ma dbyangs can ma/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /myur byon= /tshe yi dngos= /rta phyugs= /rin chen= /'bru yi= /gos dar= /zas skom= /dbang thang= /dpal 'byor= /longs spyod= /snyan grags= /'khor= /mthu dpal = /bsod nams= /dngos grub= /gzhan yang tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /klu rgyal nor rgyas la sogs pa/ /lha yi nor lha thams cad dang*/ /klu yi nor lha= /gnod sbyin nor= /srin po'i nor lha= mkha' 'gro'i nor lha= /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /nor lha'i rigs rnams thams cad kyang*/ /dar dkar=

/bkra shis= /myur byon= /tshe yi= /rta phyugs= /rin chen= /'bru yi= /gos dang = /zas skom= /dbang thang = /dpal 'byor= /longs= /snyan grags= /'khor= /mthu= /bsod nams= /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /kyai rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi/ /byin rlabs nus mthu gzi brjid g.yang*/ /dar dkar g.yob cing spyan 'dren no/ /dzam la tshogs kyi bdag po sogs/ /nor lha 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod g.yang*/ /dar dkar g.yob cing spyan 'dren no/ /tshangs pa brgya sby-in la sogs pa/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsod nams dpa' 'byor= /dar dkar= /nor rgyas dga' bo 'jog po sogs/ /klu chen brgyad= /bsod nams= /dar dkar= /nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa/ /gza' chen brgyad= /bsod nams= /dar dkar= /smin drug snar ma la sogs pa/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsod nams= /dar dkar= /lha klu sde brgyad thams cad dang*/ /gtsang rigs dpal mgon thams cad kyis/ /bsod nams= /dar dkar g.yob cing spyan 'dren no/ /kyai phyogs rnams kun du yongs khyab pa'i/ /dgung sngon nam mkha' yangs pa'i g.yang*/ /dar dkar g.yob cing spyan 'dren na/ /bkra shis 'byung gnas 'dir 'dus shig /rin chen bzhi las grub pa yi/ /ri rab lhun po mtho ba'i g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis 'byung gnas= /'jig rten khams kun gsal byed pa'i/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal ba'i g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /sra zhing 'thas pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'byung ba sa yi khams kyi g.yang*/ /dar dkar=/ bkra shis= /rlan zhing gsher ba'i rang bzhin can/ / 'byung ba chu'i khams= /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /tsha zhing bsreg pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'byung ba me yi khams kyi g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /yang shing g.yo ba'i rangabazhin can/ /'byung ba rlung gi=

/dar dkar= /bkra shis= /'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gser nya sogs/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gi g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa dang*/ /'dod pa kun 'jo ba yi g.yang*/ /dar dkar= /bkra shis= /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /g.yang gi rigs rnams thams cad kyang*/ /dar dkar= /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /thams cad gnas 'dir 'dus nas ni/ /bdag dang yon gyi bdag po yi/ /g.yang rten rdzas la thim gyur cig /ri bo bzhin du brtan par shog /rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil bar shog /ston sprin bzhin du phyugs par shog /ljon shing bzhin du rgyas par shog /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ /de nas/ kyai skyabs yul dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams phyir zlog cig /lus la bar du gcod pa zlog /tshe la bar du gcod pa zlog /srog la bar du gcod pa bzlog /rgyud la bar du gcod pa zlog /'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i gnod pa zlog /gdon gyis bskyed pa'i gnod pa zlog /gos kha ngan pa'i gnod pa zlog /mi kha ngan pa'i gnod pa bzlog / 'thab rtsod 'khrugs pa'i= /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /chags chen nyam nga thams cad zlog /mdor na mi 'dod rgud pa'i tshogs/ thams cad gtan du phyir zlog cig /kyai 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /phun tshogs dpal kun 'byung ba yi/ /bkra shis thams cad stsal du gsol/ /tshe srog brtan pa'i bkra shis shog /longs spyod 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /bsod nams rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /snyan grags rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bsam don 'grub pa'i bkra= /dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra=

/lha yi bkra shis kun thob shog /klu yi bkra shis kun thob shog /gnod sbyin bkra= /mi yi bkra shis= /mi min bkra= /bkra shis thams cad thob gyur nas/ /rtag tu bde skyid ldan pa shog / de nas g.yang rten sbyin bdag lta bu la ster bar 'dod na // //kyai de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /dzam bha la sogs nor lha kun gyi g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba= /de ring nyi ma gza'= /lha yi longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /klu yi longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams pa longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /gnod sbyin longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog/de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /lha min longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /mi yi longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtshor ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /srid pa'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/

/longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /de ring nyi ma gza' skar bzang bo la/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang rnams thams cad kyang*/ /yon bdag bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir ster/ /longs spyod 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /ces brjod la sbyin no/ /g.yang rten gyi rdzas gtsang sar bzhag nas phyi'i gzhan la mi ster/ de nas sngar nor lha'i bskyed chog byas pa yin na de bstun/ thams cad rten yod med kyis rten bzhugs dang gshegs gsol gang rung bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang ban bon dad ldan 'ga' res 'di lta bu zhig thub na gyis zhes bskul ba ltar shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/nor lha'i skyed chog g.yang 'bod byed tshul bcas bzhugs/ - PAGE 278-- PAGE 279-- PAGE 266-
